svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Evidence coverage by event year
svg.desc: Bar chart of all 375,378 events in the MedRadar snapshot by event year. The 1966–2015 aggregate is 240,494 events; 2016 to 2026 range from 10,504 to 13,308 events per year. 2026 is a partial year (snapshot 2026-10-31).
